lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Once upon a time, at the edge of a wide and peaceful forest, there lived a little mouse who loved exploring.
lines.performance_direction: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse knew every berry bush, every hollow log, and nearly every winding path beneath the trees.
lines.performance_direction: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One afternoon, the mouse wandered farther from home than usual.
lines.performance_direction: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There had been so many wonderful things to eat — tiny seeds beneath the tall grass, sweet berries beside the stream, and one particularly delicious acorn that took much longer to enjoy than expected.
lines.performance_direction: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By the time the mouse finally looked up, the golden afternoon light had begun to fade.
lines.performance_direction: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The shadows beneath the trees were growing longer.
lines.performance_direction: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: Oh! It's getting late!
lines.performance_direction: startled realization, then hurried but playful

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Still holding the acorn, the mouse stood up. Then the little traveler set it carefully beside a stone at the stream.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Home was still quite a distance away.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There were two ways to get there.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One was the familiar path that curved safely around a sunny meadow.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The other was much shorter.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It cut straight through a quiet part of the forest that the mouse rarely visited.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse looked at the darkening sky.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then at the long path.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then at the shortcut.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: The shortcut. Definitely the shortcut.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I'll be home before the stars come out!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And off the mouse hurried.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Past a mossy stone.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Under a fallen branch.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Around an old tree stump.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse ran faster and faster, thinking only of getting home.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: What the mouse did not notice was the enormous lion sleeping beneath a great old tree.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His mane rested against the grass.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His eyes were closed.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And one enormous paw stretched directly across the path.
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse rounded a root—
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: and—
lines.performance_direction: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse tripped over the lion's paw.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There was a tumble, a roll, and a very surprised little mouse landed right against the lion's enormous nose.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion's eyes opened.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: What in the forest was THAT?
lines.performance_direction: startled, deep and imposing but not frightening

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion lifted his head in surprise. The mouse scrambled down onto the path.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Before the mouse could scramble away, one enormous paw came down beside the tiny traveler, blocking the path.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse froze.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Only moments earlier, getting home before dark had seemed like the biggest problem in the world.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Suddenly, it did not seem very important at all.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You woke me from the finest nap I've had all week.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Why were you racing through here without watching where you were going?

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I'm sorry! I was eating by the stream, and I didn't notice how late it had become.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I took a shortcut because I wanted to get home before dark.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I wasn't trying to disturb you. I promise.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion looked down.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse was trembling.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He could easily have frightened the little creature even more.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He could have become angry.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: After all, he was the strongest animal for miles around.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But being able to frighten someone did not mean that he had to.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion's expression softened.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: you certainly chose an exciting shortcut.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Go home, little one.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: And next time, look where you're running.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: You're... letting me go?

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You made a mistake.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You meant no harm.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: I see no reason to hurt you for that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse stared up at the lion.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Anger was what had been expected.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Instead, the lion had chosen kindness.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I won't forget this.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I hope someday I can show someone the same kindness.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Perhaps you will.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Now hurry.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Those stars you were worried about are almost here.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse smiled and hurried home.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But this time...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: a little more carefully.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Days passed.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse returned to the usual routines of the forest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And the lion returned to his favorite shady tree.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Neither of them expected that their paths would cross again so soon.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then, one morning, something small beneath the leaves caught the lion's eye as he walked through a distant part of the forest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He stepped closer.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His paw pressed a hidden trigger, and a soft rope net dropped from the branches above.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The net settled over him, leaving his paws safely on the ground.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He tried one careful tug.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But the knotted ropes held firm.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Why won't this break?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion was powerful.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But strength alone could not free him.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At last, he let out a deep call for help.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It echoed through the forest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And far away, two little ears lifted.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse knew that voice.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: The lion!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse ran toward the sound.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Over roots.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Between bushes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Under branches.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: This time there was no shortcut and no thought of getting home.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Someone was in trouble.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: That was reason enough to run.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At last, the mouse reached the straight forest path.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There was the lion, caught inside the great net.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Little one?
lines.performance_direction: surprised and embarrassed, trying to remain composed

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You should stay back. These ropes are too strong.
lines.performance_direction: surprised and embarrassed, trying to remain composed

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: I've tried everything.
lines.performance_direction: surprised and embarrassed, trying to remain composed

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse looked carefully at the ropes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: They were certainly much bigger than the mouse.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But being smaller than a problem did not mean there was nothing you could do about it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse stepped closer.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: Maybe they're too strong for your paws.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: But perhaps they're not too strong for my teeth.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: Your teeth?

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: They're small.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: But I have quite a lot of them.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse found the rope holding a fold of the net closed. With both little paws holding it steady, the mouse began to gnaw.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nibble.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Gnaw.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One tiny bite at a time.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The ropes were thick.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The work was slow.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And more than once, it seemed as though such a tiny creature could never make a difference.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But the mouse kept going.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The fibres frayed, one tiny bite at a time.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: At last, the rope parted.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The mouse let go and stepped safely aside.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The opening widened.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion stepped through, and the loosened net slipped onto the path behind him.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He was free.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You did it.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You actually did it.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I told you my teeth might help.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: For a moment, the great lion simply looked at the tiny mouse.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The strongest creature in that part of the forest had been rescued by one of the smallest.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You came to help me even though you didn't have to.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: You were kind to me when you didn't have to either.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: So you repaid what I did for you.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: I don't think kindness works like that.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: When you let me go, you didn't give me a debt.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: You showed me what kindness looks like.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: Today I saw someone who needed help.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: So I helped.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: Maybe someday, someone else will do the same.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion became quiet.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He had always thought of strength as something that belonged to the biggest paws...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: the sharpest claws...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: or the loudest roar.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But now he understood something he had not understood before.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Strength could also mean choosing gentleness when you could choose anger.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And being small did not mean being powerless.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion smiled.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Later, beneath the great old tree, the two new friends rested together.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: You know...

lines.speaker: LION
lines.text: for someone so small, you have rather large ideas.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.text: And very useful teeth.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lion laughed.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And the mouse laughed too.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: From that day forward, whenever either of them found someone who needed help, they remembered what had happened beneath the old tree...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: and inside the hunter's net.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Because kindness is not a debt that must be repaid.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Kindness is something we can pass on.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And sometimes, one small act is enough to begin another.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Kindness does not create a debt. It creates more kindness.
